### [llm 0.32.1](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/21/llm/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-21

LLM 0.32.1 fixes broken fresh installations by explicitly pinning the OpenAI Python library dependency to 'openai<3'.

- Fresh installs of LLM failed after the OpenAI Python library removed its httpx dependency, which LLM previously relied on transitively.
- Version 0.32.1 resolves the issue temporarily by pinning 'openai<3'.
- An upcoming 0.33 release will migrate the underlying HTTP client library from httpx to httpx2.

**Why it matters:** This release restores functionality for new LLM installations impacted by unannounced upstream dependency changes in the OpenAI SDK.

`llm` `openai` `httpx` `python`

### [llm-openrouter 0.7](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/21/llm-openrouter/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-21

Version 0.7 of the llm-openrouter plugin updates compatibility for LLM 0.32, allowing users to view LLM reasoning traces and access new server-side tools via OpenRouter.

- Updated for full compatibility with LLM 0.32, enabling the display of reasoning traces from OpenRouter models.
- Transitioned models to use OpenRouter's implementation of the Responses API.
- Added support for three new server-side tools: Shell, WebFetch, and WebSearch, which can be enabled using options such as -T WebSearch.

**Why it matters:** Users can now leverage OpenRouter's reasoning outputs and built-in web search, fetching, and shell execution capabilities directly through the LLM CLI.

`llm` `openrouter` `cli` `plugins`
